title: Mellurboo's Ping Protect
description: ⛓️Protect High Ping Players from Frustrating death and disadvantage in a balanced way
body:
# Mellurboos Ping Protect
Protect Players from the drama of high ping in a fair managable way,

## Capabilities
- **Automatic Protect based on Ping**: Set a threashold for when ping protect should automatically step in
- **Configurable**: set how often it checks to ensure it scales nicely and works well especally for large servers with multi-thousand concurrent players
- **Give Players the Choice**: If it becomes more annoying than the lag itself, a player can simply run `/pingprotect optout` and then `/pingprotect optin` when they're ready!

![Example Usage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c417493d4fd294218a24c3b20006f725cab468f7.png)

![Optout Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb849ce56f215369874de71ef6067ddf8ef2eedf.png)

![Optin Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1319a5e54ba2c8b178503f08b476df03e7613ca9.png)

```
ping-max: 750

# this can be taxing, use it sparingly (value in ticks, 20ticks = 1second)
check-interval: 40

notify-player: true

messages:
  protected: "§eYour ping is high (%ping%ms). You are temporarily protected."
  unprotected: "§aYour ping is back to normal (%ping%ms). Protection removed."
  admin-protected: "§eAn admin has manually enabled protection for you."
  admin-unprotected: "§aAn admin has removed your protection."
  opted-out: "§aYou have opted out of ping protection. You will no longer be frozen or protected when your ping is high."
  opted-in: "§aYou have opted back in to ping protection. You will be protected automatically when your ping is high."
```
